title: Reports site ownership
responsibility: Binds a reports server to its application checkout and delegates repository-identity ownership checks.

inputs.name: ownedBySite.project
inputs.description: Project path whose ownership should be checked.

outputs.name: reportSite
outputs.description: Cached site root, primary-checkout directory name and repository identity. On first call uses trimmed HARNESS_SITE_ROOT or the current directory, resolves the Git root when available, and falls back to the requested directory.

outputs.name: ownedBySite
outputs.description: Result of comparing the configured site root with the supplied project path through the shared same-site helper.
